how_to_verify: rebuild the ledger and re-verify the chain; compare open/close to the ledger rows

what_is_filled: 44 official games (Weeks 7-10 2026), 37 identity checks, 96 club-week reconciliations against the card badges, 0 mismatches

how_to_verify: recompute sum W vs sum L and each vintage table from the standings read; diff the feed against the schedule pages

what_is_filled: model_fair_line_* filled on every market the model can price, plus the raw value before rounding
what_is_blank_and_why: market_line_* and difference_* blank on every row with a status string and flag D966-F01

what_is_filled: two tables with independent ranks; signal ranked on Brier skill against each event's own base rate and on absolute error versus a naive line; staking reports units, drawdown, streaks and a z statistic
what_is_blank_and_why: nothing structural; six rows are unranked because they sit below the 20-leg floor (D966-F08)
how_to_verify: the verifier rejects any stake, unit, payout or ROI column in the signal table and any error, Brier, calibration or hit-rate column in the staking table

requirement: Track the DEPTH of a replacement, not just that a replacement happened
what_is_filled: 347 report rows -> 213 club-position groups with tiers-dropped lower bounds per unit, and 11 headline evidence rows of which 3 credit a named backup taking the start

requirement: Correlations only from officially sourced numbers, with n published beside each value

what_is_blank_and_why: every candidate that needs a market price or a per-player statistic - 5 rows, published as exclusions with what would unlock them
how_to_verify: no row may omit n; a coefficient must lie inside its own interval

requirement: A DEMOTION GATE that sends a live strategy back to paper
what_is_filled: 10 gates x 10 strategies = 100 evaluated rows with observed value, threshold and verdict; 1 promotion, 9 held; the live -> paper edge is exercised by a test with real numbers
what_is_blank_and_why: a historical demotion record: nothing was live before this run, so the first publication can only promote - the standing test rows are published instead of a claim
how_to_verify: a live strategy must have zero failing gates; a paper one must name a failure or a not-evaluated row

what_is_filled: four families: 134 singles, 3 multi-game parlays, 13 same-game parlays, all settled with push handling

what_is_filled: sample floor, naive-baseline comparison, break-even interval test, calibration drift, edge decay, drawdown budget, Kelly sanity, chain, standings and feed identities
